name: singlet_embedding_viz_out_of_sample_placement
title: Place new cells on a fixed 2D map
description: Places query cells on an existing 2D reference map without re-optimising the reference. Use the default umap_transform unless a comparison needs another method. Needs reference and query PCs in one feature space, fixed reference 2D coordinates and a query flag. Writes query 2D coordinates, an optional 2D kNN label vote and an out-of-reference score. Do not use it to build a joint embedding, or to call a cell novel from its 2D position alone.

dataset.description: Dataset handle: a .singlet path, URI or workspace handle.

method.description: Placement method. Use umap_transform unless a comparison requires another.

reference_embedding.description: obsm member with fixed 2D reference coordinates; query rows ignored.

query_key.description: obs column true for query cells; all other cells are reference.

device.description: Execution device; auto prefers CUDA when memory allows.

dry_run.description: Return an estimate only; write nothing.

overwrite.description: Replace existing output members instead of failing.

n_epochs.description: Fixed epoch count, so placement does not depend on batch size.

perplexity.description: Perplexity of affinities to reference neighbours.

learning_rate.description: Numeric rate; not auto, which is avoided for transform.

initialization.description: Initial placement of each new point.

scoring.description: Label vote and out-of-reference score settings, applied to every method.

label_key.description: Reference label column; omit to skip the label vote.

label_k.description: Reference neighbours in the 2D label vote.

ood_k.description: Neighbours in the PCA-space out-of-reference score.

dataset.description: Handle of the dataset that was (or would be) updated.

status.description: completed: placed and wrote members; dry_run: estimate only; queued: long job (see job_id).

wrote.description: Members written; empty for dry_run and queued.

summary.description: Compact summary for completed calls: method, query count, label and score settings, seed.

provenance_id.description: Id of the provenance record appended to the dataset (null unless completed).

estimate.description: Present for dry_run: seconds, peak_memory_gb, device.
